test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which Indian city will host the 2023 International Olympic Committee session?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Mumbai__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The International Olympic Committee (IOC) on 19 February 2022 awarded India the right to host the IOC Session in Mumbai in 2023.
 
• India will host the session for the first time since 1983.
 
• It will be hosted at Jio World Convention Centre.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• An IOC session is the annual meeting of the members of the IOC, comprising 101 voting members and 45 honorary members.
 
• It discusses and decides on the key activities of the global Olympics movement including the adoption or amendment of the Olympic Charter, the election of IOC members and office bearers and the election of the host city of the Olympics.
 
• 
 
Adille Sumariwalla is the current President of the Indian Olympic Association (IOA).
